sets.title: Reflexive Categories
sets.description: Identify and use the four types of reflexive verbs
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите и используйте четыре типа возвратных глаголов

items.prompt: Which type of reflexive verb is 'умываться' (to wash one's face)?
items.promptEnglish: Which type of reflexive verb is 'умываться' (to wash one's face)?
items.hint: The action is performed on oneself
items.explanation: Умываться is true reflexive: the subject washes their own face.

items.prompt: Which type of reflexive verb is 'встречаться' (to meet each other)?
items.promptEnglish: Which type of reflexive verb is 'встречаться' (to meet each other)?
items.hint: Two or more people doing something to one another
items.explanation: Встречаться is reciprocal: the subjects meet each other.

items.prompt: Which type of reflexive verb is 'начинаться' (to begin)?
items.promptEnglish: Which type of reflexive verb is 'начинаться' (to begin)?
items.hint: The subject doesn't act on itself or others
items.explanation: Начинаться is intransitive: the lesson begins (no object, no self-action).

items.prompt: Which type of reflexive verb is 'бояться' (to be afraid)?
items.promptEnglish: Which type of reflexive verb is 'бояться' (to be afraid)?
items.hint: This describes a feeling, not a physical action
items.explanation: Бояться expresses an emotional state: being afraid.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these reflexive verbs by their meaning type

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ перед зеркалом. (She is getting dressed in front of the mirror.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She is getting dressed in front of the mirror.
minimalPairs.explanation: Reflexive: she dresses herself. Одевает would need a direct object.

minimalPairs.context: Мама _____ дочку. (Mom is dressing her daughter.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Transitive: mom dresses someone else (дочку). No -ся needed.

minimalPairs.context: Они _____ каждую неделю. (They see each other every week.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: They see each other every week.
minimalPairs.explanation: Reciprocal: they see each other. Видят would mean they see something.

minimalPairs.context: Фильм _____ в восемь. (The film begins at eight.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Intransitive: the film begins by itself. Начинает would need an object.

blanks: Я _____ каждое утро. (I wash my face every morning.)
Ты _____ слишком медленно. (You get dressed too slowly.)
Он _____ темноты. (He is afraid of the dark.)
Мы _____ в парке. (We meet each other in the park.)
Они _____ перед сном. (They wash up before bed.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Reflexive verb conjugation across all persons
hints: Я + умываться. After vowel ending, use -сь

items.explanation: After vowel endings (я моюсь, мы моемся), -ся shortens to -сь. After consonants (он моется), it stays -ся.

items.prompt: Она _____ рано утром. (She gets up early in the morning.)
items.promptEnglish: Она _____ рано утром. (She gets up early in the morning.)
items.explanation: Она просыпается: third person singular of просыпаться.

items.prompt: Вы _____ в шесть? (Do you get up at six?)
items.promptEnglish: Вы _____ в шесть? (Do you get up at six?)
items.explanation: Вы просыпаетесь: second person plural/formal of просыпаться.

sets.title: Transitive vs Reflexive Pairs
sets.description: Choose between transitive and reflexive verb forms
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите между переходными и возвратными формами глаголов

minimalPairs.context: Мама _____ малыша. (Mom is washing the baby.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Transitive: mom washes someone else (малыша). No -ся.

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ холодной водой. (He washes himself with cold water.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He washes himself with cold water.

minimalPairs.context: Учитель _____ урок. (The teacher begins the lesson.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Transitive: the teacher begins something (урок). No -ся.

minimalPairs.context: Концерт _____ в семь. (The concert starts at seven.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Intransitive: the concert starts by itself. Use -ся.

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ ребёнка. (She is dressing the child.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Transitive: she dresses someone else (ребёнка). No -ся.

blanks: Бабушка _____ внука. (Grandma is dressing her grandson.)
Директор _____ собрание. (The director is ending the meeting.)
Брат и сестра часто _____. (Brother and sister often argue.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Choosing between transitive and reflexive verb forms
hints: The boy washes himself (no object) - reflexive
The film ends by itself - intransitive reflexive
They argue with each other - reciprocal reflexive
explanations: Мальчик моется: reflexive, he washes himself (сам confirms).
Бабушка одевает внука: transitive, she dresses the grandson (direct object).
Фильм кончается: intransitive, the film ends by itself.
Директор кончает собрание: transitive, he ends the meeting (direct object).
Ссорятся: reciprocal, they argue with each other.

errorCorrection.explanation: When dressing oneself (сам), use the reflexive: одевается.
The lesson begins by itself (intransitive). Use начинается.
They meet each other (reciprocal). Use встречаются.
Mom washes someone else (ребёнка is the object). Use transitive моет.

sets.title: Emotional & State Verbs
sets.description: Practice reflexive verbs for emotions and states
sets.descriptionRussian: Практикуйте возвратные глаголы для эмоций и состояний

items.prompt: Мы _____ за тебя. (We worry about you.)
items.explanation: Мы беспокоимся: first person plural of the emotional state verb.

items.prompt: Он _____ новой работы. (He is afraid of the new job.)
items.promptEnglish: He is afraid of the new job.
items.explanation: Он боится: third person singular. Бояться takes genitive (работы).

items.prompt: Дети _____ подарку. (The children are happy about the gift.)
items.promptEnglish: The children are happy about the gift.
items.explanation: Дети радуются: third person plural. Радоваться takes dative (подарку).

items.prompt: Ты _____ по дому? (Do you miss home?)
items.explanation: Скучать (to miss) is not reflexive. Ты скучаешь по дому.

items.prompt: Она _____ на шум. (She complains about the noise.)
items.explanation: Она жалуется: third person singular of жаловаться.

items.prompt: Я _____ спортом. (I do sports / am involved in sports.)
items.explanation: Я занимаюсь: first person singular. Заниматься takes instrumental (спортом).

translation.explanation: Бояться (emotional state) takes genitive. Собак is genitive plural of собака.

translation.english: We are happy about the vacation.
translation.explanation: Радоваться (to be glad) takes dative. Каникулам is dative plural of каникулы.
Беспокоиться о (to worry about) + prepositional. Сыне is prepositional of сын.
Жаловаться на (to complain about) + accusative. Погоду is accusative of погода.

blanks: Дети _____ экзаменов. (The children are afraid of exams.)
Мы _____ за маму. (We worry about mom.)
Они _____ подарку. (They are happy about the gift.)
Студент _____ на экзамен. (The student complains about the exam.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Emotional and state reflexive verbs with correct case government
explanations: Дети боятся: они form. Бояться + genitive.
Мы беспокоимся: мы form. Беспокоиться за + accusative.
Она занимается: она form. Заниматься + instrumental.
Они радуются: они form. Радоваться + dative.
Студент жалуется: он form. Жаловаться на + accusative.

sets.title: Mixed Reflexive Challenge
sets.description: All reflexive verb types in context
sets.descriptionRussian: Все типы возвратных глаголов в контексте

items.prompt: Библиотека _____ рядом с парком. (The library is located near the park.)
items.promptEnglish: The library is located near the park.
items.explanation: Находится: intransitive reflexive meaning 'is located'. Находит means 'finds'.
Одевается: reflexive, the boy dresses himself (сам confirms).

items.prompt: Они _____ каждые выходные. (They see each other every weekend.)
items.promptEnglish: They see each other every weekend.
items.hint: Reciprocal: seeing each other; они form
items.explanation: Они видятся: reciprocal reflexive, they see each other.

items.prompt: Музей _____ в десять. (The museum opens at ten.)
items.explanation: Открывается: intransitive reflexive. The museum opens (no one is opening it).

items.prompt: Ты _____ экзамена? (Are you afraid of the exam?)
items.promptEnglish: Are you afraid of the exam?
items.explanation: Ты боишься: second person singular of бояться.
